title: Wonderful day
text:
David was a wonderful tour guide. He contacted us before the tour and took care of everything including making lunch reservations for us which is a must during the busy tourist season. He was very knowledgable and passionate about the rich history of the area. When I wanted to find unique gifts he took us off the main tourist path to a small shop where we could watch a man handcraft silver jewelry. The jewelry is very traditional, unique, beautiful and reasonably priced. 

Sadly the tour company that offers this tour is very disorganized and we were so lucky to have David who went above and be
author: Sherry_B

title: Great experience
text: Miguel was our guide. He was a lot of fun and very knowledgeable about Cordoba and the history of the town. We really enjoyed the tour & highly recommend it. It was a great and memorable experience. He even gave us a side driving tour if Carmona & gave us tips and ideas of more things to do during our stay in Seville.

title: Satisfied
text: It was a beautiful day. The meeting point had three stations, and they were very helpful when it came to changing the name in case you had logged on to the farthest station but arrived at the nearest. The tour was explained clearly, concisely and helpfully by Nieves, so there was no boredom. There was plenty of time for sightseeing and eating. Departure and return were on time. I was thrilled! ^-^

title: Great experience
text: Cordoba is a place well worth visiting. We had Carlos as our tour guide, he is very knowledgeable about the sites, the itinerary was very well thought out and he speaks good English. He also took us to a very good restaurant for lunch. My wife forgot her phone in the car and Carlos was kind enough to bring it back to our hotel. I highly recommend this tour operator.
